title: Find your request: list, card, search and continuation
goal: Find the intended request and resume your own work after closing the application.

prerequisites.text: Your first saved 30-minute request and its actual number/customer are known.

sections.title: A list contains several records
paragraphs: A list is an overview; a card represents one record. A selected row does not itself mean you are editing that document. Double-click opens it; Create begins a new one. Before editing check the card’s number, date and customer. Similar comment text is insufficient identification.

Keep the first 30-minute request. Create a separate 45-minute request for your second customer using the same training service and status Новая. Record its actual number. Two distinguishable documents make a wrong selection visible.

sections.title: Select by number rather than similar text
paragraphs: Several documents can share a customer or comment.

code.source:
First request: 30 minutes.
Second request: 45 minutes.
Find first number → open → verify 30.
code.output: The first saved request is open.

sections.title: Search reduces the visible list
paragraphs: List search selects displayed rows; it does not delete other documents. Enter the first request’s exact number, apply search, open the result and compare its number and 30 minutes. Clear search afterwards to show both records.

For an empty result verify the relevant list rather than application-wide search, then check your infobase, number and other filters. Do not immediately create a duplicate. First establish whether the record is actually absent.

sections.title: Verify one change and preserve the other record
paragraphs: Find the first request by number, append проверена навигация to its comment, write and reopen. The second request must retain 45 minutes and its own comment. This checks more than a changed value in an unclosed form.

If your version offers navigation history, it may reopen a card. It is not a backup or a general undo facility. Report the route actually used: the list and number are sufficient; no universal History button is required by this lab.

sections.title: An empty search is reversible
paragraphs: The visible selection changed; stored records did not.

code.source: Search for an absent number → empty → clear search

sections.title: Return to the same work tomorrow
paragraphs: Close your application normally, reopen the same startup entry and find the document by its saved number. Stored state must be readable independently of the preceding window. Save a semantic lesson step in Nexus; that is a learning position, not a mirror of the 1C window.

The assistant can explain instructions and recall a saved local lesson step. It does not automatically know external windows or unsaved fields. Supply an observation rather than asking it to guess. Reloading Nexus does not itself test external infobase persistence.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Create opens the selected record. It begins a new document; open an existing row separately.
Navigation history restores all data. It is navigation; data backup is a separate mechanism.

selfcheck.prompt: A search produces no rows. What comes first?
selfcheck.feedback: List visibility differs from persisted record existence.

selfcheck.prompt: How do you edit the earlier request?
options: Find its number and open its row
Create a customer with the same name

selfcheck.prompt: What does Nexus automatically know about external 1C?
options: It does not automatically observe the external window
selfcheck.feedback: Saved lesson position is not external application monitoring.

selfcheck.prompt: Change the first comment, restart the application and prove the second record stayed unchanged.
selfcheck.feedback: Read both numbers after reopening; only the first record changed.

practice.title: Two requests and safe continuation
practice.task: Change the first comment, restart the application and prove the second record stayed unchanged.
practice.environment: Personal training documents; Nexus and 1C windows are not synchronized automatically.
practice.externalRoute: Enterprise → request list; Nexus → saved lesson position

steps.title: Prepare distinguishable records
steps.action: Verify the first 30-minute request. If the second is absent, create a new one for Учебный Юг with your service, 45 minutes, status Новая and comment Второе учебное обращение. Write it and retain both actual numbers.
steps.why: Two records expose a wrong selection.
steps.expected: Two separate requests contain 30 and 45 minutes.
steps.troubleshooting: If the second customer is missing, return to the customer-card lesson and create it separately; do not rename the first.
steps.before: Open the same personal practice infobase as before.

steps.title: Find the first request
steps.action: Enter its number, apply search (usually Enter), double-click the row and compare number and 30 minutes.
steps.why: Bind the action to an identified document.
steps.troubleshooting: For no match check infobase, list, number and filters before creating anything.
steps.before: Two separate requests contain 30 and 45 minutes.

steps.title: Change only its comment
steps.action: Append проверена навигация to your comment, write and close. Clear search, open the second by number and inspect its preceding fields.
steps.why: One edit must not affect its neighbor.
steps.expected: First comment changed; second retains 45 minutes and its own text.
steps.troubleshooting: For the wrong card cancel the unsaved edit and find the first number.

steps.title: Check empty visibility
steps.action: Close the card. Search for a deliberately absent number, apply it and obtain no rows. Use × to clear search and find both original records.
steps.why: An empty selection is not deletion.
steps.expected: Both records remain available by their original numbers.
steps.troubleshooting: If absent afterwards, inspect other filters and the infobase before changing data.
steps.before: First comment changed; second retains 45 minutes and its own text.

steps.title: Continue after reopening
steps.action: Close your session, reopen the same infobase and read both requests again. In Nexus select your current step and record the next action briefly.
steps.why: Distinguish persisted records, application navigation and lesson position.
steps.expected: Both documents are readable; Nexus position is not claimed as an external-window observation.
steps.troubleshooting: If the assistant lacks the actual 1C result, provide an invented-record number and your observation without personal information.
steps.before: Both records remain available by their original numbers.

criteria: Exact number and 30 minutes; other documents remain available.
Second document has 45 minutes; the empty result is reversible without creating/deleting records.
Read both numbers after reopening; only the first record changed.
Both actual numbers and fields after reopening.
Empty search, clearing it and the second request unchanged.
Do not delete or recreate documents after an empty search. Clear conditions and verify the intended infobase first.
practice.hint: It begins a new document; open an existing row separately.

exercises.task: Find the first request by number, open it, check fields and clear search.
exercises.criteria: Exact number and 30 minutes; other documents remain available.

exercises.task: Find the second request, then a deliberately absent number.
exercises.criteria: Second document has 45 minutes; the empty result is reversible without creating/deleting records.

exercises.task: Change the first comment, restart the application and prove the second record stayed unchanged.
exercises.criteria: Read both numbers after reopening; only the first record changed.
